title: A test suite for a library
description:
Write a small date library and a thorough test suite for it with `node:test`.

```
node --test
✔ parses ISO dates (1.2ms)
✔ refuses 2026-02-30
✔ adds months at the end of a month (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28)
...
tests 14, pass 14, fail 0
```
hints: `addMonths` clamps the day to the length of the new month (lesson 8.04).
Write each test name as the behaviour it checks; a failing name then tells you what broke.
requirements: Functions `parseDate`, `addDays`, `addMonths`, `daysBetween` and `format`, working on `{ year, month, day }` objects (no `Date` time zone surprises).
At least 12 tests, including leap years, month ends and bad input.
Run them with `node --test` on your machine, or with the tiny runner from this milestone's practice here.
